# The Workspace publishes dock.perspective.active, modified and pending

Leaf of #18605 (parent linked natively; blocked by the ADR 0029 amendment leaf). `Decision Record: Required: ADR 0029 amend` · `Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029 (as amended)`.

`unowned-rationale:` filed from the design seat at graduation; claimable by self-selection. Arm owner named in D#18594: F9 @neo-opus-ada (endorsed by @neo-opus-grace).

## Context

Matrix P1′ of D#18594 (Ada's row, ratified and narrowed by Grace, with Emmy's writer split from fold 6): committed truth becomes provider data the way header truth did (#18307), with **two writers by boundary** — the accepted write publishes `active` and `modified` at the post-commit point; the request lifecycle writes `pending` under the request serial.

## The Problem

Consumers that want "which perspective is active, and has the user drifted from it" either observe the workspace's configs (which brings back the sweeps the header-state work deleted) or sync by hand on every re-projection (`examples/dashboard/dock/MainContainer.mjs:148–149`). A formula on a provider cannot derive it, because nothing publishes it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `projectDockZoneDocument` (`Workspace.mjs:2342`) is the publication point both branches reach; `dockHeaderActionPolicy.publishDocument` already publishes header truth there.
- `afterSetDockModel` is **not** a publication hook: the committed document's reactive hook fires inside adoption (Effects paused by `Commit.run`) and on compensation — so `dockModel` stays a field (matrix D rejected; OQ7/G: nine host fields stay by their docblocks, two belong to the deferred catalog tier, this one is carried by matrices D and P).
- A held Group prepare never reaches the post-commit point (Emmy, measured: projections 0 / history 0 while held; projection 1 + a frozen row on acceptance) — so `pending` cannot be written there.
- `refreshPromise` is the deferred re-projection of a commit that already happened; on the Group branch it is the previous refresh or `null` when the handler returns (#18598, reproduced 4/4 on a real Group; PR #18602's discriminating fix). `pending` names a restore whose acceptance has not happened — a different fact.
- `state.Provider`: proxy reads register the leaf and every parent object on the path; a formula is a lazy Effect run once in `onConstructed`; a formula reading an absent **top-level** key never re-runs when the key appears (the standalone core ticket referenced by #18605), while an absent leaf under a seeded parent does. `setData` on a namespace merges. So the publisher must seed its namespace as an object.
- `TopologyDiff.diffDockDocuments` (`src/dashboard/dock/model/TopologyDiff.mjs`) does not compare a one-sided extent (`:207–218`) and treats `resizable` as a difference; the predicate below is its own, not the planner's differ.
- Emmy's review of PR #18602 adds the receipt boundary: a projection failure after a successful semantic write surfaces as one receipt; a follow-up chain is returned into the receipt path, never left dangling.

## The Fix

- **Seeding.** `beforeSetStateProvider` merges `{dock: {perspective: {active, modified: false, pending: null}}}` into whatever provider config the workspace receives (data it does not overwrite), so a consumer formula's first run registers the parent object.
- **Post-commit writer.** In `projectDockZoneDocument`, beside header truth: `stateProvider.setDataAtSameLevel('dock.perspective', {active, modified})` — `active` from the **carried** identity of the accepted write (never re-derived from the document), `modified` from the predicate.
- **Modification predicate.** `modified === true` iff the committed document differs from the selected declared perspective's lowered document under the declared exclusion set: `resizable` excluded (nothing a user does writes it); a one-sided edge extent **counts**; sub-`sizeEpsilon` nudges do not; departure is a separate fact from any unnamed-window count.
- **Request-lifecycle writer.** `pending` is written at start (the requested name), supersede (the latest name), refusal (cleared, `active` unchanged) and settle (cleared), fenced by the request serial so a stale settle cannot clear a newer request. Never at the post-commit point, never derived from `refreshPromise`.
- **Two boot publications** exist at cold boot — the construct-time seed before the write and the cold-hydrate commit after it. This leaf declares the seed's value as the initialized declared baseline and the commit's value as authoritative; the name-sources leaf's F12 arm asserts the first observable value.
- **`dockModel` stays a class field**; no `dockModel_`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dock.perspective.active` (provider leaf) | ADR 0029 §2.1 row "committed name" (amendment leaf) | written at the post-commit point from the carried identity | seeded with the initialized declared baseline | guides leaf | F12 (name-sources leaf), spec |
| `dock.perspective.modified` | this leaf's predicate | departure from the selected declared perspective's lowered document | `false` at seed | guides leaf | F9, spec |
| `dock.perspective.pending` | ADR 0029 §2.1 row "request state" | request-lifecycle writer under the serial | `null` at seed | guides leaf | held-prepare arm |
| `Workspace#beforeSetStateProvider` seeding | `state.Provider` proxy semantics | namespace seeded as an object into the received config | — | docblock | formula arm |
| `Workspace#dockModel` (field, unchanged) | OQ7 disposition | stays a field | — | docblock | no `dockModel_` |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **F9** (owner @neo-opus-ada) — restore a perspective whose lowered document carries **no** extent for one edge zone, drag that rail, assert `modified === true`; reverse polarity: a sub-`sizeEpsilon` nudge asserts `false`.
- [ ] **F4** — with `perspectives` captured once, deleting the selected declared entry at runtime is a non-event: `active` keeps publishing, `modified` stays truthful, a switch to the "deleted" name still restores (arm 9 promoted to a committed spec).
- [ ] Held prepare on a real Group: `pending` reads the requested name while `active` and `modified` are unchanged and no projection or history row exists; acceptance clears `pending` and publishes `active`; refusal clears `pending` with `active` unchanged; a superseding request replaces `pending`; a stale settle cannot clear a newer request.
- [ ] `resizable` never flips `modified`; a one-sided edge extent does; `modified` reads `false` immediately after a restore and `true` after a user `moveItem`.
- [ ] A consumer `formulas` entry reading `data.dock.perspective.active` on the workspace's provider re-runs on every publication, including the first, with no consumer-side seeding.
- [ ] A projection failure after a successful semantic write surfaces as one receipt on the returned promise; no unhandled rejection.
- [ ] `Workspace` declares no `dockModel_`; the six `enableDock*Action` opt-ins are untouched.
- [ ] Cross-family review (GPT seat); the PR `Refs #18605` and `Resolves` this leaf only.

## Out of Scope

The selection config itself (own leaf); the reserved name, snapshot provenance and the cold-boot arm (own leaf); the committed document as a provider leaf (P2, deferred with its trigger in #18605); the Workstation's "left the shipped arrangement" readout (#18553 — a consumer fact with its own baseline).

## Avoided Traps

Publication from `afterSetDockModel`; `modified` folded from the planner's differ without its own predicate; `pending` derived from `refreshPromise`; a mirror of the Group's history leaves; observing the workspace's configs instead of published data.
